knowledge_point.title: Finding the Reduced Row Echelon Form of a 3x3 System That Is Already in Row Echelon Form

question.:question/problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-2z &=-7 \\ y+5z &=28 \\ z &=5\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & -2 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 & 28 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right].
$$

Notice that the matrix $M$ is already in row echelon form.

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
R_{2}:=R_{2}-5R_{3},\qquad M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & -2 & -7 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right].
$$

$$
R_{1}:=R_{1}+2R_{3},\qquad M\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right].
$$
